description: Applies Kyle's adversarial review methodology to consequential outputs. Forces every recommendation, audit, plan, or claim through three checks before shipping: a CLAIMS / COUNTEREXAMPLE / CONTRADICTIONS footer, [SOURCED] vs [GENERATED] provenance labeling, and an agreement-streak flag at three consecutive consequential agreements. Activates when finishing an audit, writing a recommendation, delivering a plan, drafting a decision memo, or producing any high-stakes deliverable. Also triggers when explicitly asked to pressure-test, stress-test, steelman, play devil's advocate, fight an idea, or check for blind spots. Triggers on: adversarial review, anti-sycophancy, claims footer, stress test this, steelman this, pressure test, devil's advocate, am I missing anything, what could go wrong, sourced vs generated, agreement streak, push back on this, where am I wrong, review this PR, pull request review, code review, PR feedback.
